nodes.label: HAG-54 Report: Inventory Slice Dead-Button Wiring
nodes.rationale: No source file in the assigned set was modified because every control was already wired to a live endpoint and the 12 alerts in InventoryDashboard.jsx are success/error toasts inside real try/catch blocks, not stubs. Blocker found outside the slice: 21 files under src/ import ../utils/localDate (wrong relative depth - the module sits one level up) and Vite returns 500 'Failed to resolve import' for them, raising the HMR overlay that covers the login form and makes the whole app effectively unclickable in-browser; this is also the pre-existing failure mode of tests/dead-buttons-audit.spec.js and tests/hotel-bookings.smoke.spec.js. A temporary workaround patched a Vite error string inside node_modules to get verification running, but the underlying localDate resolution failure remains and must be fixed in src/.
